title: sideritis pusilla subsp. granatensis
intro: Sideritis pusilla subsp. granatensis, commonly known as Granada Ironwort, is a plant species within the Sideritis genus, characterized by its small size and ironwort-like appearance. This plant is traditionally used to support respiratory health, with its reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in alleviating coughs and relieving bronchitis symptoms. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis pusilla subsp. granatensis include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of Granada Ironwort, particularly flavonoids and phenolic acids, are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and optimal usage.
